sources.title: Magic Enum metadata sequences and optional operators
sources.version_or_date: live master; no dated release inspected
sources.sections_read: README enum_values, enum_names, enum_cast, enum_contains, and optional operator sections
sources.confirmed: The primary repository supplies enum metadata sequences and checked conversions, with additional flag and bitwise operations in separate headers. Examples use scoped enum classes.
sources.limits: It relies on modern C++ enum semantics and reflection, not Python 2006; numeric aliases collapse in reflection, compiler-specific scans have bounds, and a deliberate order policy and closed Python member universe still need design. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C10.json.

sources.title: limitations.md
sources.version_or_date: live master; no dated release inspected
sources.sections_read: Enum Range, Aliasing, Operators, and reflection backend sections
sources.confirmed: The compiler-specific backend has a bounded scan range, aliases can share one reflected name, and broad operator namespaces can affect unrelated enums. These limitations prevent treating reflection as a complete domain-isolation solution.
